text: Introduction The world economy, or global economy, generally refers to the economy, which is based on economies of all of the world's countries' national economies. Global Economics majors study economics in the context of a particular geographic area, incorporating language study, area study, and study abroad into their academic plan. Teaching Objectives Students who complete the program will develop a sound understanding of economics in an international context, focusing particularly on one geographic area. The program also increases the educational opportunities of graduates to develop critical thinking skills and gain experiential learning opportunities in the area of international economics. Internship Students will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, visits to companies, and career consultation. Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Master Degree of Economics in World Economy by Central China Normal University. Future Career Employment opportunities for well-trained graduates in Global Economics are excellent in government, international trade and finance, and industry.
